description: This file declares client-side functions for inter-process communication (IPC) in C, including service availability checks, waiting for services, sending requests with optional timeouts, and shutdown procedures. It is specifically tailored for IPC using JSON payloads encapsulated in IPCMessage objects, supporting both C and Java services.

methods.name: isServiceAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the local service at the specified port is available and accepting requests.

methods.name: waitForServiceAvailable
methods.description: Blocks until the service becomes available or the timeout expires.

methods.name: sendServiceRequest
methods.description: Sends an IPC request to the specified service and retrieves the response.

methods.name: sendServiceRequestTimeout
methods.description: Sends an IPC request with a timeout for the response.

methods.name: ipcSenderShutdown
methods.description: Initiates shutdown for all pending IPC senders.
